annotations.title: Is the sky worth a look tonight

description: Tonight's verdict for a Polish city: worth it, maybe or not, and why; the dark hours and the clearest stretch, MET Norway's cloud cover hour by hour, the moon's phase and whether it is up, a visible ISS pass, the chance of the aurora, the planets up and a meteor shower near its maximum. Warsaw when no place is given.

city.description: One of the 18 Polish voivodeship seats, e.g. "Kraków", "Gdańsk", "Warsaw" (Białystok, Bydgoszcz, Gdańsk, Gorzów Wielkopolski, Katowice, Kielce, Kraków, Lublin, Łódź, Olsztyn, Opole, Poznań, Rzeszów, Szczecin, Toruń, Warszawa, Wrocław, Zielona Góra)

lang.description: Language of the answer: pl (default) or en

lat.description: Latitude of another place: the nearest seat is used
